lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ج/و   n–j–w elevation, highland, a place too high for flooding to reach
; to escape, to deliver, to rescue; speed, to run quickly; to remove dirt from oneself, to cleanse oneself; to cut, to flay; to confide, to confer in secrecy, to consult with 1 another.

Of this root, 11 forms occur 84 times in the Qur’an:
نَجَا najā 2 times; نَجَّى najjā 36 times; نُجِّيَ nujjiya 1 time; أَنْجَى ʾanjā 23 times; نَاجَى nājā 1 time; تَنَاجَى tanājā 4 times; ناجي nājı 1 time; نَجَاةٌ najātun 1 time; نَجِيٌّ najiyy 2 times; نَجْوىَ najwā 11 times and مُنَجِّي munajjı 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نَجَّى najjā [v. II trans.]

1 to rescue, to deliver, to conduct to safety

(17:67) فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّا but when He brings you safely to land

2 to spare

(10:92) فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ so today We save you [only] in body

3 to protect, to shield

(66:11) رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِى الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ my Lord, build a house in Your Garden for me: protect me from Pharaoh and his doings.

entries.label: نَجَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
نَجَّى najjā [v. II trans.]

1 to rescue, to deliver, to conduct to safety

(17:67) فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّا but when He brings you safely to land

2 to spare

(10:92) فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ so today We save you [only] in body

3 to protect, to shield

(66:11) رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِى الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ my Lord, build a house in Your Garden for me: protect me from Pharaoh and his doings.

entries.label: أَنْجَى
entries.definitionHtml:
أَنْجَى ʾanjā [v. IV trans.]

1 to deliver, to rescue, to conduct to safety

(2:50) وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ الْبَحْرَ فَأَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ and when We parted the sea for you [also interpreted as: by your going through it] and thus saved you and drowned Pharaoh’s people

2 to protect

(29:24) اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنْجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ slay him, or burn him!–but God protected him from the Fire

3 to spare

(61:10) هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى تِجَارَةٍ تُنْجِيكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ shall I guide you to a bargain that will spare you from painful punishment?

entries.label: تَنَاجَى
entries.definitionHtml:
تَنَاجَى tanājā [v. VI intrans.] to exchange confidences, to confer together in privacy

(58:9) إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلاَ تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَةِ الرَّسُولِ when you converse in private, do not confer with [a view to] sinful doings, aggression, or disobedience to the Messenger.

entries.label: مُنَجِّي
entries.definitionHtml:
مُنَجِّي munajjī [act. part. of v. II, pl. مُنَجُّون munajjūn] one who brings to safety; rescuer, deliverer

(29:33) إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ We will certainly save you and your household.

entries.label: نَاجَى
entries.definitionHtml:
نَاجَى nājā [v. III trans.] to confer with, to speak privately with, to exchange confidences with

(58:12) إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً when you come to speak privately with the Messenger, offer something in charity ahead of your private conferring.

entries.label: نَاجِي
entries.definitionHtml:
نَاجِي nājı [act. part.] one who escapes, one who goes free

(12:42) وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ نَاجٍ مِنْهُمَا and he said to the one who, of the two, he deemed would go free.

entries.label: نَجَا
entries.definitionHtml:
نَجَا najā ū [v. intrans.]

1 to go free

(12:45) وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا then the one of the two who had gained freedom said

2 to escape, to reach safety

(28:25) لاَ تَخَفْ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ do not fear, you have escaped from the unjust people.

entries.label: نَجَاة
entries.definitionHtml:
نَجَاة najātun [n.] deliverance, rescue, salvation

(40:41) مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَاةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire.

entries.label: نَجِىّ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَجِىّ najiyy

1 [v. n./act. or pass. part.] the act of sharing confidences/intimacies, conferring or consulting in private; one who engages or is engaged with someone else in private consultation or conversation

(19:52) وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا and We called to him from the right‐hand side of the Mount and brought him close in intimate conferring (or, a conferring person)

2 [v. n./coll. n.] people in a secret conference

(12:80) فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْئَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا نَجِيًّا when they despaired of [retrieving] him, they withdrew to one side, a conferring group.

entries.label: نَجْوَى
entries.definitionHtml:
نَجْوَى najwā [v. n./n.] private consulting or conferring; confidences exchanged in private, intimacies, private conversation

(58:7) مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلاَثَةٍ إِلاَّ هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ there is no secret conference of three without Him being their fourth.

entries.label: نُجِّيَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نُجِّيَ nujjiya [pass. v.] to be delivered, to be aided

(12:110) جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَشَاءُ Our help came to them and whoever We willed was saved.
